original.statement: CronOperation and WatchOperation are new API resources added to Crossplane 2.0.0.

decision.reason: [ev-edf630e684ee] says CronOperation and WatchOperation were added in 2.0.0. The CRD validator confirmed that ops.crossplane.io/v1alpha1 CronOperation exists only in the target release [ev-e2735e756cbf], so the group, version and kind in the gvk-in-use condition are correct for the fixed subject. The kind is new and the consequence is none, so before the upgrade no environment can be using it, and gvk-in-use only flags environments that adopt the kind afterwards. That fits an added GVK. The upstream item also adds WatchOperation [ev-d8a9fd80558b], which this subject leaves out and which would need its own assertion; the canonical validator found no standard exposure shape for an added GVK, so my confidence is low.
